notes_for_editor: Fact-check 2026-10-21: the full NHLR Georgia list (29 names) has no boggy pond. The tower list gives no elevation unit, so the story now says so instead of asserting feet. Only the compiled tower list places a tower here. Lake-Link describes a lake of this name near Pembroke, but no source ties the tower to that lake. The 'Ron topo' note is not explained; the list credits Gary Weber and Ron Stafford with tower locations in general. No datasheet number is given for this entry, so no NGS check is possible. No photos. Consider holding the story until a register, Georgia Forestry Commission or news source turns up.
